description: Semantic HTML table with token-based styling. Exports Table, TableHeader, TableBody, TableRow, TableHead, TableCell.

TableHead.header.description: Column header text. Replaces TableHead children: ReactNode.

TableCell.value.description: Cell display value. Replaces TableCell children: ReactNode for simple cells.

note: For data-driven table rendering, use DataTable organism with columns: DataTableColumn[]. TableCell children: ReactNode still supported for custom cells.
